ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMEREMPLOYMENT_CCD
AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment AS
(
	   SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY InsertDttm DESC ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT
    BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
	,HASHBYTES('MD5', BCM.CUST_EMP_NAME) AS EmployerId
	,BCM.CUST_OCC_CODE AS JobTitleId
	,BCM.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,BCM.CUST_ANN_SALARY AS AnnualSalaryAmount
	,BCM.CUST_EMP_TYPE AS EmploymentClassificationId
	,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,NULL AS EmploymentStatusId
	,NULL AS EmploymentNote
	,NULL AS EmployeeId
	,NULL AS NatureOfIncome
	,BCM.CUST_OCC_PER AS PeriodOfOccupation
	,'CCD' AS SourceCode
	,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BCM.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
    ,RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCMD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM
    ON BCMD.CUST_NBR = BCM.CUST_NBR AND BCMD.CUST_STATUS = BCM.CUST_STATUS
	AND BCM.isLatest = 1
UNION

SELECT
    BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
	,HASHBYTES('MD5', BCD.CUST_EMP_NAME) AS EmployerId
	,BCD.CUST_OCC_CODE AS JobTitleId
	,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,BCD.CUST_ANN_SALARY AS AnnualSalaryAmount
	,BCD.CUST_EMP_TYPE AS EmploymentClassificationId
	,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,NULL AS EmploymentStatusId
	,NULL AS EmploymentNote
	,NULL AS EmployeeId
	,NULL AS NatureOfIncome
	,BCD.CUST_OCC_PER AS PeriodOfOccupation
	,'CCD' AS SourceCode
	,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BCD.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
    ,RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
    ON BCDD.CUST_NBR = BCD.CUST_NBR AND BCDD.CUST_STATUS = BCD.CUST_STATUS
	AND BCD.isLatest = 1
	   )A
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,EmployerId
,JobTitleId
,PeriodStartDate
,AnnualSalaryAmount
,EmploymentClassificationId
,PeriodOfOccupation
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,EmployerId
,JobTitleId
,PeriodStartDate
,AnnualSalaryAmount
,EmploymentClassificationId
,PeriodOfOccupation
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE SourceCode = 'CCD' AND PeriodEndDate IS NULL
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = CONVERT(DATE, CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL

---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmployment  ( 
	CustomerId
	,EmployerId
	,JobTitleId
	,PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate
	,EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,AnnualSalaryAmount
	,EmploymentClassificationId
	,EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,EmploymentStatusId
	,EmploymentNote
	,EmployeeId
	,NatureOfIncome
	,PeriodOfOccupation
	,SourceCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.EmployerId AS EmployerId
	,SRC.JobTitleId AS JobTitleId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,SRC.AnnualSalaryAmount
	,SRC.EmploymentClassificationId
	,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,NULL AS EmploymentStatusId
	,NULL AS EmploymentNote
	,NULL AS EmployeeId
	,NULL AS NatureOfIncome
	,SRC.PeriodOfOccupation AS PeriodOfOccupation
	,'CCD' AS SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId

 


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmployment  ( 
	CustomerId
	,EmployerId
	,JobTitleId
	,PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate
	,EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,AnnualSalaryAmount
	,EmploymentClassificationId
	,EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,EmploymentStatusId
	,EmploymentNote
	,EmployeeId
	,NatureOfIncome
	,PeriodOfOccupation
	,SourceCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,EmployerId AS EmployerId
	,JobTitleId AS JobTitleId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,AnnualSalaryAmount
	,EmploymentClassificationId
	,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,NULL AS EmploymentStatusId
	,NULL AS EmploymentNote
	,NULL AS EmployeeId
	,NULL AS NatureOfIncome
	,PeriodOfOccupation AS PeriodOfOccupation
	,'CCD' AS SourceCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA;


END
